Subscription.label: Abonnements
Subscription.schema: CREATE TABLE subscriptions (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT, plan_type VARCHAR(50), status VARCHAR(20), monthly_price DECIMAL(10,2), annual_price DECIMAL(10,2), annual_discount DECIMAL(10,2), stripe_customer_id VARCHAR(255), stripe_subscription_id VARCHAR(255), started_at DATETIME, expires_at DATETIME, cancelled_at DATETIME, created_at DATETIME, updated_at DATETIME)

Payment.label: Paiements
Payment.schema: CREATE TABLE subscription_payments (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, subscription_id INT, user_id INT, amount DECIMAL(10,2), currency VARCHAR(3), stripe_payment_intent_id VARCHAR(255), stripe_invoice_id VARCHAR(255), status VARCHAR(20), payment_type VARCHAR(20), period_start DATETIME, period_end DATETIME, created_at DATETIME)

Addon.label: Addons
Addon.schema: CREATE TABLE subscription_addons (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255), description TEXT, monthly_price DECIMAL(10,2), active TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1, created_at DATETIME, updated_at DATETIME)

UserAddon.label: Addons Utilisateurs
UserAddon.schema: CREATE TABLE subscription_user_addons (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, subscription_id INT, addon_id INT, user_id INT, status VARCHAR(20), started_at DATETIME, cancelled_at DATETIME, created_at DATETIME)

PaymentMethod.label: Méthodes de Paiement
PaymentMethod.schema: CREATE TABLE subscription_payment_methods (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT, stripe_payment_method_id VARCHAR(255), card_type VARCHAR(20), card_last4 VARCHAR(4), card_exp_month INT, card_exp_year INT, is_default TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, created_at DATETIME)
